section_or_row: L8-L14 COMPLETE_*/ACCEPTABLE_*/PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED_* rows; conflicts with ES-GPS-CLOSE-001 and MD §16
finding_summary: Closure/continuation readiness rows omit elements that ES-GPS-CLOSE-001 and MD section 16 require for every closure determination.
exact_evidence: CLOSE-001 requires exact scope, evidence, exclusions, retained findings, exception records, permitted claims, prohibited claims, and reopening triggers. COMPLETE_WITH_FOUNDER_CERTIFIED_HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_EXCEPTION required_evidence lists FCR-01 recovery/substitute/uncertainty/prohibited claims but not scope, residual risk, or reopening trigger. COMPLETE_WITH_FOUNDER_TEST_WAIVER omits scope and reopening trigger. COMPLETE_WITH_PILOT_EVIDENCE_SUBSTITUTION omits residual risk, prohibited claims, and reopening trigger. ACCEPTABLE_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT omits scope/risk/prohibited/reopening fields entirely.
failure_mode: A reader could treat matrix required_evidence as the complete closure checklist and omit retained risk or reopening triggers.
impact: Weakens closing-audit usability before first activation/closing audit.
required_correction: Expand each COMPLETE_*/ACCEPTABLE_* /PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED_* required_evidence cell to explicitly require scope, exception/certification IDs, evidence relied upon, permitted claims, prohibited claims, retained risks, and next review/reopening trigger (or an explicit 'inherits all FCR-xx required_fields including reopening_triggers' statement).
acceptance_criterion: Every closure-like readiness row enumerates all CLOSE-001 required elements or fully incorporates the controlling FCR required_fields set by reference.

finding_summary: Waiver/substitution template omits schema-required fields date, certifying_founder, and authority_effect.
exact_evidence: FOUNDER_CERTIFICATION_MACHINE_READABLE_SCHEMA.json required includes date, certifying_founder, authority_effect. Template provides Certification or waiver ID, Certification class, Founder disposition, and Expiration or review trigger, but no Certification date, Certifying Founder, or Authority effect fields. Contrast FCR-01 template which includes Certification date and Certifying Founder.
failure_mode: Completed waiver templates can be treated as durable records while failing the machine-readable schema required set.
impact: Operational certification recording gap for FCR-03..08 and FCR-10.
required_correction: Add checklist fields: Certification date; Certifying Founder; Authority effect. Align labels to schema property names or provide an explicit mapping table.
acceptance_criterion: Every schema.required property has a corresponding template capture field for classes covered by the waiver template.

section_or_row: VAL-016 L398; related VAL-015 L392; VAL-019 L416
finding_summary: VAL-016 passes human/machine agreement by citing common generation rather than independently comparing authoritative Markdown headings to JSON section pointers.
exact_evidence: VAL-016 evidence: 'Both are generated from the same rule catalog and matrix model.' Independent comparison finds 13 stale catalog markdown_section values and 9 stale ADV markdown_section values (CB-001/CB-002). VAL-015/019 similarly PASS on rule-ID presence without verifying section-heading resolution.
failure_mode: Validator self-satisfies from generator provenance instead of authoritative source files, allowing concrete cross-file defects to receive PASS.
impact: False confidence in package readiness; defects escaped the package's own deterministic gate.
required_correction: Replace VAL-016 (and strengthen VAL-015) with checks that every markdown_section string exists as a Markdown heading and that cited matrix_row_id tokens resolve to CSV/schema identifiers; fail on mismatch.
acceptance_criterion: Re-running validation fails on current head until CB-001/CB-002 are fixed, then passes by heading/ID resolution against package files.

finding_summary: Validation report still marks CI as PENDING_LIVE_PR_CHECK while live PR #77 checks have passed and package status claims READY_FOR_REVIEW.
exact_evidence: VAL-030 result PENDING_LIVE_PR_CHECK. Observed live checks on PR #77 all pass (Backend known-failure gate, Backend collectable, Frontend build, Vercel, Vercel Preview Comments). Package/final_revision_status remains READY_FOR_REVIEW with retained warning that live CI is reported after push.

impact: Minor evidence hygiene issue; not an authority defect.
required_correction: Either refresh VAL-030/status to record observed passing check run IDs for head 95672eac..., or downgrade package wording so READY_FOR_REVIEW does not imply completed live-CI closure inside the validation report.
acceptance_criterion: Validation report CI field matches an explicitly cited live check conclusion for the frozen head, or is clearly labeled historical pre-push pending without READY closure implication.

finding_summary: Permitted transition allows Founder certification while still in DRAFTING, before UNDER_REVIEW/FOUNDER_APPROVED/ADOPTED.
exact_evidence: TR-020 condition: 'Founder certification resolves a bounded process/evidence gate.' Parallel happy-path is TR-002..TR-005 through review and approval.
failure_mode: Not necessarily defective if certification remains bounded and non-adopting, but it is a shortcut around review sequencing that operators could over-read.
impact: Low if FCR prohibited claims and authority_effect remain enforced; worth clarifying in MD lifecycle text.
required_correction: Optionally add explicit MD/matrix note that TR-020 cannot create adoption, lock, activation, implementation, pilot, or production authority and must cite an FCR class with scope limits.
acceptance_criterion: TR-020 row or MD lifecycle section states hard non-implications matching ALACA/PROHIBITED overclaims.
notes: No concrete bypass of FCR-10/production rules found.
